source.title: Forebears Morocco forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public Morocco frequency tables were used as a Morocco-administered-region sample seed for this disputed-territory GEO. This is not a Sahrawi civil registry source, so names remain review-quality.

phones.notes: ANRT confirms Morocco country code 212 and nine-digit national significant numbers, with fixed geographic numbers under 5 and mobile numbers under 6/7 after removing the domestic 0. The 528/529 fixed prefixes are retained as Morocco-linked southern-territory review prefixes; generated numbers are not assignment-checked.

source.title: Morocco DGCT Laayoune-Sakia El Hamra and MUAT Dakhla-Oued Ed-Dahab regional monographs

locations.notes: Official Morocco regional material confirms the administrative-region context used for Laayoune and Dakhla, but the dataset does not claim a separate Western Sahara postal authority or address-valid postcode grammar. Postal prefixes and streets remain generator review seeds.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Morocco ordinary passport document entries

passport.notes: PRADO confirms Moroccan passport document families relevant to Morocco-administered issuance, but no Western Sahara-specific public passport-number grammar was confirmed. The one letter plus eight digits template remains an unconfirmed synthetic placeholder.
